lines.text: Before we name what happened — look at what the data shows.
Gateway traffic hit 14 times baseline. Outbound. From multiple hosts at once.
Files across three departments were encrypted within four minutes of each other.
And 47 staff were locked out of their accounts at the exact same timestamp.
These three things happened together. That pattern means something. What do you think it is?
This is its signature: get in, encrypt the files, lock out the users, and demand payment — all while exfiltrating data through that outbound channel.
The simultaneity is the tell. Humans don't move that fast. Automated malware does.
In a hospital, this isn't just an IT problem. Delayed lab results. Inaccessible patient records. Automated dispensing offline.
Real patients. Real risk. That's why this work matters.
You identified it. First mission complete. SENTINEL is logging your analysis.
